thesis: The speaker describes his non-traditional career path from banking and venture capital to academia and advising sovereign wealth funds, noting that his early experiences in finance were more self-serving and focused on fee streams than the long-term value creation he originally envisioned. He explains that his perspective shifted after 9/11, which prompted him to quit his previous roles and pursue a different direction in the financial services industry.
